keyword: when was the last nasa launch
claims: The last NASA crewed launch was Artemis II.
Artemis II was the first crewed flight around the moon since 1972.
Four astronauts were aboard the Orion spacecraft on Artemis II.
Artemis II launched from Launch Complex 39B at NASA's Kennedy Space Center.
The crew of Artemis II was Reid Wiseman, Victor Glover, Christina Koch (NASA), and Jeremy Hansen (Canadian Space Agency).
The mission duration of Artemis II was 10 days.
Artemis II aimed at testing systems for future lunar landings.
The Space Shuttle Program concluded with STS-135 on July 8, 2011.
STS-135 was the last shuttle flight.
